notes.title: Emily is Away
notes.content:
[h3]Jump back in to the Emily series today with Emily is Away <3![/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/978460/Emily_is_Away_3/][b]Available now on Steam![/b][/url]

Emily <3 is a brand new game on an entirely new platform! Sign into Facenook today for wall posts, poke wars, note surveys and more! Chat with your friends Emily, Evelyn and now Mat! Navigate your way through the branching narrative and see if your senior year ends in heartbreak or true love! In short: It's complicated.

[previewyoutube=4XCCbNgaWaA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Longevity Update[/h2]
Along with the new game, Emily is Away is also getting a longevity update. This includes an engine upgrade and new builds for Mac OSX users! 

Thank you everyone for the continued support of my silly little games. It means the world to me!

notes.title: Emily is Away Too is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10876263/1c00244580e680b0b9f48a59da7a4a2a34a56a47.gif[/img]
[h1]Emily is is Away Too is out for PC, Mac and Linux.[/h1]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/523780/Emily_is_Away_Too/]Get it on Steam![/url]

Emily Too is a brand new story featuring new characters and multiple different endings. Message both Emily and Evelyn as you determine the outcome of your senior year. Extend the story past the chat window with youtube links, facebook profiles and file transfers. And most importantly, change your text color to lime green so everyone knows you're the coolest kid in school.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10876263/20d9b47cbf2ab73d287b3b9f57040bc91e26c62c.gif[/img]
